game.title: Forza Horizon 5
game.blurb: Open-world racing set in Mexico, from Playground Games, released 2021-11-08. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, including the Hot Wheels and Rally Adventure expansions.

chapters.summary: Arrive in Mexico, buy cars, build the Outposts and reach the Hall of Fame.
